CORRECTION_r302.what: the deposited resolved_par was the WARM START, not this run's result, and the deposited speed was therefore the warm start's speed
CORRECTION_r302.cause: run_faststart_r294.py's best_par() selected the minimum objective encoded in the .par filename. The warm start was optimised under min_velocity = 1.0 and scores 0.988; every genuine result under min_velocity = 1.5 scores 21-23 because of the speed penalty. So 0.988 was the numeric minimum in the directory and the resolver returned the starting point.
CORRECTION_r302.why_unnoticed: the warm start was copied into the results directory under a name beginning with a digit, so it matched the [0-9]*.par glob, and its .sto was the only one present when the deposit was written
CORRECTION_r302.fix: select by HIGHEST GENERATION among the run's own outputs and exclude the staged warm start by name. Implemented as best_par_by_generation() in run_dfsevere_r293.py. Selecting by objective is unsafe for any arm whose warm start was optimised under a different objective.
CORRECTION_r302.scope: r289 is NOT affected: its warm start is H1922v7b3-TSG3Dv8g-989_fixed2.par, which does not match the [0-9]*.par glob, so its resolved_par values are genuine run outputs. Verified.
